invalid_reasons: n below the spec minimum of 30 (runs=30, resource_runs=10; --allow-small-n/--quick)
notes: density capped at 16 sandboxes (spec: 500) to keep this host safe
network policy: `disabled` on every backend (egress_restricted is unenforceable in V1)
docker: bind-mount cost is inside spawn_ready (compare W1/W2 vs W0); ws_attach is the post-ready list_dir verification

libkrun: workspaces are live virtio-fs shares (no attach / sync-back cost); without a cgroup leaf (always on macOS) memory is the helper's RSS (mem.helper_rss_*), which counts shared pages fully: not comparable with the Linux PSS columns
docker: mem.guest_available reads the host /proc/meminfo (no lxcfs), so it is not a per-sandbox number
